title: Saffron and its active constituents ameliorate hypercholesterolemia by inhibiting PCSK9 and modulating Sortilin, LDLR, and SREBP-2 signaling in high fat diet induced hypercholesterolemic C57BL/6 mice.
authors: Siddiq A, Aisha; Dileep, Shaik Abdul; Sj, Aditya Rao; Singam, Siva Sankara Reddy; Martin, Asha
one_liner_zh: 该文研究藏红花提取物通过抑制PCSK9改善高胆固醇血症，虽含分子对接与模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦TF-DNA结合，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Saffron (Crocus sativus L.) has long been used in Ayurveda, Iranian, and Chinese traditional medicine as a natural remedy for hypercholesterolemia, obesity, and liver disorders though its therapeutic mechanism remains unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study explores the mechanism by which saffron extract (SE), crocin (CN), and crocetin (CR) mitigate high fat diet (HFD) induced hypercholesterolemia and hepatic inflammation in C57BL/6 mice, focusing on their inhibition of proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9). MATERIALS AND METHODS: C57BL/6 mice (N = 10/group) were fed either a, normal diet, HFD, or HFD supplemented with SE, CN, CR, or atorvastatin for 12 weeks. Plasma lipids and inflammatory markers were measured. Histopathological changes were assessed via H&E and Sudan black staining. Gene expression was analyzed using qRT-PCR, and ligand-protein interactions were studied using molecular docking, simulation, and thermophoresis. RESULTS: HFD-fed mice exhibited dyslipidemia, liver damage, and inflammation, which SE, CN, and CR significantly improved. Treatments reduced cholesterol, triglycerides, and reactive oxygen species, reversed fatty liver degeneration, and downregulated PCSK9 and sortilin expression while upregulating LDLR. They suppressed transcription factors SREBP-1C and SREBP-2 and reduced inflammatory markers, including TNF-alpha, while increasing IL-10 expression. CR reduced plasma PCSK9 secretion by 39.9 % (p < 0.05). Docking and simulation studies confirmed the strong binding potential of CR and CN to PCSK9. CONCLUSION: Saffron and its active components (CN and CR) are novel natural PCSK9 inhibitors that effectively ameliorate hypercholesterolemia by modulating sortilin, LDLR and SREBP-2 pathway, potentially opening the way for developing new therapeutic approaches for managing cholesterol related disorders.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：藏红花（Crocus sativus L.）长期以来在阿育吠陀、伊朗和中国传统医学中被用作治疗高胆固醇血症、肥胖和肝脏疾病的天然药物，但其治疗机制尚不清楚。研究目的：本研究探讨了藏红花提取物（SE）、藏红花素（CN）和藏红花酸（CR）减轻高脂饮食（HFD）诱导的C57BL/6小鼠高胆固醇血症和肝脏炎症的机制，重点关注它们对前蛋白转化酶枯草溶菌素/kexin 9型（PCSK9）的抑制作用。材料与方法：C57BL/6小鼠（每组N = 10）分别喂食正常饮食、HFD，或补充SE、CN、CR或阿托伐他汀的HFD，持续12周。测量血浆脂质和炎症标志物。通过H&E和苏丹黑染色评估组织病理学变化。使用qRT-PCR分析基因表达，并使用分子对接、模拟和热泳法研究配体-蛋白质相互作用。结果：HFD喂养的小鼠表现出血脂异常、肝损伤和炎症，而SE、CN和CR显著改善了这些状况。治疗降低了胆固醇、甘油三酯和活性氧，逆转了脂肪肝变性，并下调了PCSK9和分拣蛋白（sortilin）表达，同时上调了低密度脂蛋白受体（LDLR）。它们抑制了转录因子SREBP-1C和SREBP-2，并减少了炎症标志物（包括TNF-α），同时增加了IL-10表达。CR将血浆PCSK9分泌减少了39.9%（p < 0.05）。对接和模拟研究证实了CR和CN与PCSK9的强结合潜力。结论：藏红花及其活性成分（CN和CR）是新型天然PCSK9抑制剂，通过调节sortilin、LDLR和SREBP-2通路有效改善高胆固醇血症，可能为开发管理胆固醇相关疾病的新治疗方法开辟道路。
